1.explanation:
All of the key bug elements live in codetools.ts: 

• formatHasCodeTools(format) determines whether code-tools should be shown at all (it gates HTML and Bootstrap).
• resolveKeepSource(format, engine, target) is responsible for honoring the user request to keep and embed source code when code-tools.source is set. Currently it only treats `source === true` or `source` omitted as valid, ignoring string URLs.
• resolveCodeTools(format, doc) resolves whether toggles and source should be available; it initially reads the raw `code-tools.source` (including strings) but then forces `codeToolsResolved.source = !!format.render[kKeepSource]`, which is never set for string URLs, disabling source entirely.
• codeToolsPostprocessor(format) builds the actual menu and “View Source” logic only if `format.render[kKeepSource]` or toggle flags are true.

Because string URLs for `source` aren’t treated in resolveKeepSource, `kKeepSource` is never set and thus the downstream logic in resolveCodeTools and codeToolsPostprocessor never inserts the code-tools UI. The fix is to update resolveKeepSource (and possibly resolveCodeTools) to accept string values for `source` and set `format.render[kKeepSource]` accordingly.
1.bug_scenario: The user has enabled code-tools in an HTML Quarto document and passed a remote URL string for the `source` option (e.g. `source: "https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-web/blob/main/index.md"`). When rendered, no code-tools menu or “View Source” button appears, even though the same document with `source: true` works as expected.

2.explanation:
All the core Code Tools logic lives in codetools.ts. 
• formatHasCodeTools(format) determines whether any code-tools UI should be injected (it only checks for a truthy boolean codeTools config, not a string URL). As a result, codeTools.source:string isn’t recognized as enabling Code Tools. 

• resolveKeepSource(format, engine, target) sets format.render[kKeepSource] only when codeTools is true or an object with source===undefined or source===true. It never marks keep-source for string URLs, so no embedded source is generated. 

• resolveCodeTools(format, doc) then sees keepSource unset and disables both “source” and “toggle” in the resolved CodeTools object, so the UI button never appears. 

Fixing the conditions in resolveKeepSource (and updating formatHasCodeTools/resolveCodeTools to treat string source URLs like true) will restore the menu when source=URL.
2.bug_scenario: The user has enabled the HTML “code-tools” feature in a Quarto .qmd document and pointed its “source” option at an external URL (e.g. a GitHub raw.md file). In the rendered HTML the Code Tools dropdown button never appears (no menu toggle), whereas using “source: true” works correctly (the button and menu show up). From the screenshots we see the title bar shows just the title and no “</> Code” button when source is a string URL.
